Package parking.infrastructure.repository

Class InMemoryVehicleRepository

java.lang.Object
parking.infrastructure.repository.InMemoryVehicleRepository
All Implemented Interfaces:
VehicleRepository
public class InMemoryVehicleRepository extends Object implements VehicleRepository
In-memory VehicleRepository implementation, backed by an ArrayList.

This is an "infrastructure" (outer-layer) adapter: it implements a port defined by the domain layer. Swapping it for, say, a JDBC- or file-backed implementation would require no change whatsoever to the domain or application layers, since they only ever depend on the VehicleRepository interface.
